title: When Correctness Feedback Erases Evidence: Phase-Separated Completeness Auditing in Verus
abstract: arXiv:2610.20676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Correctness feedback suppresses the very evidence that specification-completeness auditing is designed to uncover: programs that satisfy a written contract but violate intended behavior. We demonstrate this objective reversal on 12 Verus/Rust tasks across four model families under matched call budgets. Independent no-feedback discovery more than doubles certified-witness yield relative to IntentShield's corrective-feedback loop (59.0% versus 27.1%). A format-matched iterative control places the larger share of this gap in feedback content, not independent restarts. The advantage holds in every model family and survives parser repair. A separate phase-separated execution matches the aggregate yield without reusing responses; most certified witnesses also fail held-out cases. Preserving these witnesses delivers stronger specification repair: Phase-Revised contracts achieve 81.3% implementation success, versus 62.5% for IS-Revised, with Dir

translated_title: 当正确性反馈抹除证据时：Verus中的阶段分离式完整性审计
translated_abstract: 正确性反馈会抑制规约完整性审计旨在揭示的证据——那些满足书面契约却违背预期行为的程序。我们在四个模型家族的12个Verus/Rust任务上、在匹配调用预算的条件下，展示了这种目标反转现象。相比IntentShield的纠错反馈循环，独立的无反馈发现将认证见证样本的产出率提高了一倍以上（59.0%对27.1%）。一个格式匹配的迭代对照实验表明，这一差距的更大份额来自反馈内容本身，而非独立重启。这一优势在所有模型家族中都成立，并且在解析器修复后依然保持。一次独立的阶段分离执行在不复用响应的情况下达到了相同的总体产出；大多数认证见证样本在留出用例上同样失败。保留这些见证样本能带来更强的规约修复效果：Phase-Revised契约实现81.3%的实现成功率，而IS-Revised为62.5%（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究发现正确性反馈会抹除规约完整性审计所要揭示的关键证据，并提出在Verus中采用阶段分离的审计方法，使认证见证产出率翻倍以上（59.0%对27.1%），据此修复规约可将实现成功率从62.5%提升至81.3%。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that correctness feedback erases the very evidence specification-completeness auditing aims to uncover, and proposes a phase-separated auditing approach in Verus that more than doubles certified-witness yield (59.0% vs. 27.1%) and lifts specification-repair implementation success to 81.3%.
